title: Mixed Event — Bustling Cafe ●REC! — Episode8 What About The Broadcast?

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP!'s latest gig is a TV segment on location at a popular cafe! Little do they realize, it's none other than the cafe where Minori works!

rows.Line: A few weeks later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, you're all finally here!
Did you bring a recording of your show?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's start watching it right away!
What are we using? A phone? A tablet?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Relax, you guys.
We have it right here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It literally just finished airing.
We haven't seen it yet, so we're also very excited.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We refrained from watching it as it aired because we wanted to watch it with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You didn't have to do that...!
But thank you for being so thoughtful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been really wondering what the final cut looks like! I can't wait to see it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, since it sounded like your shoot couldn't have gone better.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Speaking of which...
That cafe's been trending again lately.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even before the show started airing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember how that really popular professional wrestler just happened to be there when we were shooting?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She apparently fought in a big match not long after that and won! During her victory speech, she said...

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming out to see my match today! I love each and every one of you!!

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line: I felt so invincible today that my opponents honestly didn't stand a chance! And I plan on going out for some delicious sweets after this!

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line: I haven't been able to stop going to this little cafe in Shibuya! Their parfaits definitely played a big role in my win today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, she made a post on PicShare detailing everything about that cafe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now, influencers and up-and-coming professional wrestlers alike are showing up every day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really...?!
She must be a big star...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so wonderful.
And the manager's wish of having the cafe appear on TV came true♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, your manager sounded a little worried about it getting too popular too fast.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That means it's going to become even more popular after your show airs, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, in that sense, we were extremely fortunate about being able to interview an influencer like her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, she does sound like an incredibly influential figure...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But the segment itself needs to be good for people to start talking about it. So, I believe they'll be looking out for how you all ran everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I... I hope I did okay...
I'm starting to get a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, let's see for ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to start watching too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm also a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But let's play it now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Let's see what's hot right now!
It's trend surfing time!!!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it's begun...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You all look so cute!
There's just something different about how you all appear when you're on TV compared to your streams.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Quiver*
I'm still not used to having others watch videos of me like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's nice that we get to see everyone's reactions in real-time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
I hope you all enjoy this show as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If everything went as well as you girls said it did, I'm sure it's gonna be a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. This is all so exciting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Bye, everyone! Catch you again next week! And don't forget to keep trend...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: <Surfing!!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! It's over already?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your segment felt so short.
I wish we could keep watching...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That felt longer than normal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
They usually only give this segment like ten minutes, but they gave us close to twenty.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The director did say that the interview was quite long, so maybe it's because of that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, it's not supposed to be easy to extend an individual segment like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Maybe it's because the other segments ended up being a little shorter than usual.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Or... What if they wanted to use as much of the footage as we got since it ended up being so good?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How amazing would that be?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's gotta be it!
I was on the edge of my seat the entire time!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And what a wonderful cafe.
Also, I wasn't expecting you girls to join the cafe staff.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everyone looked like they were having so much fun! I kind of want to try working at a cafe now♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. It'd be wonderful to put smiles on the faces of all of our customers while wearing cute uniforms♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why don't we open up one here? We can call it “Cafe SEKAI”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We could make tea and sweets...
And it'd be pretty fun to dress up as the staff.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, yeah! That sounds super fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I remember seeing some costumes that looked a lot like uniforms for a cafe. What if we wore those?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Good call!
We could even have a bit of extra fun by making a few alterations to them♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then, let's start planning!
Our menu's gonna have an amazing list of options...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you guys are gonna look so sharp in your uniforms as you serve customers, KAITO, Len.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Naturally, we plan to provide the best service we can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, Airi, you really do have an amazing talent for coming up with ideas.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Your quick thinking saved us again during this last shoot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The manager, Saki, Mizuki... They couldn't seem to thank you enough.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really..?!
You're amazing, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, you know praise won't get you anywhere with me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, our shoot went well not just because of me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You all did your best to improve the cafe's situation and even saw what I was trying to do to help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, I believe it was a team effort.
I would've been totally powerless on my own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best to make people laugh and smile no matter what the job involves!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!
